layout.narrowOrder: Identity, eligibility, CTA first; evaluation content follows.

dataContract: Graduation measures net quote reserves excluding fees against target; unknown progress is unavailable.
Curve uses exact BigInt ceiling model arithmetic; it is not recorded price history or an executable quote.
Allocation diagram uses supplied verified categories only; missing or invalid data stays missing.
Only contract status confirms graduation; target position is a model estimate.
Four lifecycle stages; Post-Graduation is explicitly not implemented.
Existing wallet, network, quote, transaction, eligibility, and source limitations remain authoritative.
notCanonized: Retained legacy cobalt, Newsreader, Manrope, shadow, motion, and breakpoint entries are not evidence of current source identity.
Existing functional caps labels do not establish decorative eyebrows as house style.

dos: Do preserve existing shared graphite/lime tokens, Bricolage Grotesque, and semantic light/dark behavior.
Do keep launch-prefixed treatments scoped to `/launch/[slug]`.
Do align amounts and percentages with tabular numerals and thin rules.
Do preserve identity and CTA first on narrow screens, and the existing sticky decision rail on desktop.
Do distinguish model estimates, verified allocations, unavailable data, and confirmed contract state.
Do honor reduced motion and preserve focus, accessible records, and existing wallet/transaction behavior.

rules.name: The Scope Rule
rules.body: Launch-prefixed tokens and the graphite graduation treatment belong to `/launch/[slug]`; unrelated pages retain their established tokens and composition.

rules.name: The Numeric Alignment Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for repeated amounts, percentages, chart readouts, and allocation shares so updates retain column alignment.

rules.name: The Instrument Depth Rule
rules.body: On launch detail, convey emphasis through graphite, lime, scale, and rules; do not add heavy shadows, blue illumination, or glow.

donts: Don't spread the local graphite graduation surface or page composition to unrelated routes.
Don't add blue, cream, glows, or heavy decorative shadows to the redesigned launch detail.
Don't invent allocation categories, historical price activity, eligibility outcomes, or post-graduation execution.
Don't treat retained legacy sidecar typography or cobalt tokens as current source authority.
Don't turn decorative eyebrows, glyph icons, or continuous animation into new house rules.
narrative.overview:
LumenRise's existing interface uses Bricolage Grotesque, graphite and lime, neutral surfaces, compact controls, and clear numeric hierarchy. Shared source tokens remain authoritative. This document records the current foundation and the finished `/launch/[slug]` presentation; it does not authorize a redesign of other routes.

The launch detail expresses the user-pinned direction of 60% Editorial Fintech and 40% Technical Data Visualization. Spacious project reading sits beside exact, inspectable launch information. Its graphite graduation instrument is a local exception within the light neutral page, while semantic surrounding surfaces continue to support dark mode. The code-led direction uses seed `7502b531`; no approved raster composition or separate quality card exists.
keyCharacteristics: Existing graphite and lime identity with Bricolage Grotesque throughout.
Strong tabular figures, restrained corners, thin rules, and aligned data.
A route-local graphite graduation instrument within theme-aware neutral content.
Explicit provenance and limitations beside charts and launch actions.

narrative.overview:
Launchpad should feel like a public record prepared for inspection: white paper, graphite type, exact data, and hairline rules that make every term easy to audit. Newsreader gives launches editorial consequence, while Manrope keeps amounts, requirements, and controls contemporary and precise. The result is institutional without becoming cold, and financial without borrowing the noise of a trading terminal.

The interface is compact where facts repeat and expansive where orientation matters. Large serif openings establish context; dense rows then disclose status, price, progress, timing, allocation, eligibility, and action in a stable reading order. Cobalt is scarce and purposeful, reserved for action, selection, focus, and live progress. Rounded treatments belong to controls and small status objects, never to large decorative shells.
keyCharacteristics: White editorial canvas with graphite copy and hairline ledger rules.
Newsreader display type paired with Manrope for body copy and data.
Cobalt reserved for actions, focus, active state, and meaningful progress.
Compact, tabular rows in place of card-grid dashboards.
Restrained rounding, flat depth, and crisp state changes.

rules.name: The One Cobalt Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt identifies an action, active state, focus target, or live measure; it is not page decoration.

rules.name: The Paper Is the Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep the product on white; introduce separation with rules and spacing before adding a tinted container.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Newsreader carries names, propositions, and summaries; Manrope carries instructions, controls, labels, and facts.

rules.name: The Data Must Line Up Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals wherever amounts, percentages, dates, participant counts, or scores repeat in a row or column.

rules.name: The Row Before Card Rule
rules.body: When several objects share comparable facts, use aligned rows and dividing rules before considering a card grid.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Never use a shadow to make ordinary content look important; use hierarchy, rules, and spacing.

rules.name: The Radius Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Round controls and state objects for affordance; do not round full-page sections or turn ledger rows into cards.

dos: Do begin major directories and panels with a graphite top rule, then divide repeated records with cool gray hairlines.
Do keep cobalt scarce and attach it to an action, focus target, active state, or live measure.
Do use Newsreader for editorial consequence and Manrope for exact interface language.
Do preserve clear field labels when dense desktop grids reflow on smaller screens.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences and keep keyboard focus visibly cobalt.
donts: Don't replace comparable ledger rows with a grid of floating rounded cards.
Don't add gradients, glass effects, ambient shadows, or ornamental crypto-dashboard glow.
Don't use status color without a text label or other explicit state cue.
Don't place large serif type inside dense controls, table labels, or repeated numeric data.
Don't fill the white canvas with tinted sections when a rule and spacing can establish hierarchy.
